name: Zafran Brightening Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++ 30gm | For Men & Women Daily Use
description:
Zafran Brightening Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++ 30g – For Men & Women (Daily Use)

Protect your skin while keeping it radiant with Zafran Brightening Sunscreen, specially formulated for UVA/UVB broad-spectrum protection with Blue Light Defense.

Key Benefits:

High Sun Protection: Shields skin from harmful UVA/UVB rays and blue light exposure.

Brightens & Whitens: Helps improve skin tone for a healthy, glowing complexion.

Moisturizes & Soothes: Keeps skin hydrated, soft, and comfortable even under sun exposure.

Daily Use: Suitable for both men and women, indoors or outdoors.

How to Use: Apply evenly on face and exposed areas during the day. Reapply every 2–3 hours for best results.

Key Ingredients: Stearic Acid, Butanediol, Zinc Oxide, Titanium Dioxide, Arbutin, Olive Oil, Borax, Perfume, and more.

Net Weight: 30g

Perfect for everyday sun protection with added brightening and hydration benefits.
